snippet.title: SILENT HILL: Townfall | Gameplay Trailer (4K: EN/ESRB) | KONAMI
snippet.description:
SILENT HILL: Townfall set to release on September 24th, 2026.
Pre-Order Now: https://www.konami.com/games/silenthill/townfall/
Fear the truth behind the static.
 
Explore the fog-shrouded island of St. Amelia and experience over 18 minutes of atmospheric gameplay from two sections of this brand new entry in the SILENT HILL series.
Navigating the houses and apartments of the Shorefront region, embark on the story of Simon as he is called back to the island to 'make things right.'

00:00 – Opening
01:23 – Exploring the town of St. Amelia using clues revealed by the CRTV
03:31 – Exploring Zoe's House
08:11 – First Encounter
10:58 – Entering St. Amelia's Otherworld with a Pistol in Hand
15:35 – Exploring a Tenement Building in the Otherworld

- SILENT HILL PORTAL
https://www.konami.com/games/silenthill/
